data.long_meaning: Name derived from the Old English words 'gar' meaning spear and 'wudu' meaning wood. In Old English culture, names were often descriptive of their bearer's occupation, status, or character. The name Garwood carries the meaning “Spear-wood” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Garwood usually hope their child will grow to embody spear-wood and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Garwood in Old English culture would have carried a significant impact, as it translates to 'Spearwood'. This would have suggested a warrior or protective figure, someone who was strong, brave, and a defender of their people and land. The name would have been worn as a badge of honor, and the individual would have been expected to live up to this warrior ideal.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Garwood can be seen as a reminder of the protective power of God. The spear represents strength and protection, and the wood represents God's creation and the foundation of all life. The name Garwood can be seen as a call to always be a guardian of faith and to trust in God's protection in times of uncertainty or danger.
